**Today's AI Agent News Digest**

The AI agent landscape is accelerating rapidly. Open-source agent frameworks have hit a significant production milestone, with adoption tripling as enterprises move beyond experimentation. In startups, model-driven agents are quietly replacing hand-coded orchestration, signaling a shift toward more flexible, scalable architectures. Meanwhile, tool-calling reliability has emerged as the new benchmark for frontier models, pushing developers to focus on precision and safety. Multi-agent swarms are no longer confined to demos—they're now entering regulated enterprise workflows, where compliance and coordination matter most. To support this maturation, observability standards are finally emerging, giving teams the ability to trace agent decisions end to end and build trust in autonomous systems.
